blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Segmentation networks that predict at an output stride are trained against label maps downsampled by strided sampling, nearest-neighbor resampling or majority pooling. These methods label each coarse grid cell on its own, so a region that wins no cell is absent from the target and receives no positive label. We present MatchDown, which builds the coarse target from a minimum-cost matching between regions and the grid cells they occupy. It keeps as many regions as any one-region-per-cell target can, certifies how many losses are unavoidable, and with priority tiers (MatchDown-P) keeps every evaluated region (a region that a metric scores) of at least one cell's area. On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of regions, whereas the downsampling used by StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids loses four to five times as many on COCO at factor 8. Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are different problems: we show that no region lost by majority pooling can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of the nuclei that majority pooling loses above IoU 0.5, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist's strided target. On two nucleus datasets, with thresholds cross-validated for count error, this head has instance accuracy at IoU 0.5 (Acc50) 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 points below cell-center sampling, and a lower count error than the strided and cell-center targets on BBBC039. On BBBC039, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, lowers count error relative to majority targets by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc50. MatchDown runs once, before training, in place of the label-downsampling step.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Many segmentation networks learn from labels at a coarser resolution than the image.
Grid-based object heads such as StarDist build their target by sampling the label map with a stride, lbl[::f, ::f] [ 48 ] , and nnU-Net v2 resamples the labels of its deep-supervision heads with nearest-exact interpolation [ 28 , 15 ] .
DeepLab subsampled its ground truth by 8 [ 8 ] , and connectomics pyramids pool labels 2 × 2 2{\times}2 per level with the mode [ 49 ] .
Each of these methods labels every coarse grid cell independently of the others, so a region that is not selected in any cell it touches is missing from the target ( Fig. 1 ).
These losses are not limited to tiny regions: at factor 8, the standard methods lose 150 to 195 regions of a cell or more on 1,000 COCO panoptic images, and majority pooling loses 8.8% of the nuclei of BBBC038 ( Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
许多分块网络在比图像更相近的分辨率下从标签中学习.
基于网格的物体头,如StarDist,通过用脚步来取样标签图来构建它们的目标,lbl [:f, *f] [48],而nnU-Net v2则用最近的精确插值来重新标出其深度超视头的标签[28,15].
DeepLab 以 8 [8] 的分样取出其地表真理, 连接相机金字塔池标注 2 × 2 2 × Times} 每关与模式 [49] 2 .
每种方法都将每个粗网格细胞与其它方法独立地标出标签,因此在它所触及的任何单元格中未选择的区域从目标中缺失(图1).
这些损失不仅限于小区域:在要素8中,标准方法在1000个CO光学图像上损失了150至195个或更多的细胞区域,大多数集合损失了BBBC038核的8.8%(第4.2节)。

blocks.en:
For some heads the coarse target cannot be avoided.
Grid-based instance heads such as StarDist, CenterNet and SOLO assign one object to each output cell [ 48 , 57 , 53 ] , StarDist’s 3D models predict on a subsampled grid to fit volumes in memory [ 54 ] , deep supervision needs a label at every scale [ 28 ] , and label pyramids are built once and reused [ 49 ] .
Patch-token heads of vision transformers [ 16 , 42 ] face the same choice whenever their loss is computed on the token grid rather than after upsampling.
A region missing from the coarse target receives no positive label in that image; a network may still find it by generalizing from other images, but it is not trained to.
blocks.zh:
对某些头来说,粗糙的目标是无法避免的。
StarDist, CenterNet和SOLO等基于网格的实例头为每个输出单元格分配一个对象[48, 57, 53],StarDist的3D模型在被分样的网格上预测能与内存中的容积相匹配 [54],深度监管需要每个尺度[28]的标签,标签金字塔一次被建造并被再用 [49].
视向变压器的补丁头[16,42],每当其损失在信号格网上计算,而不是在取样后,都面临同样的选择。
粗细目标所缺失的区域在该图像中没有得到正标;一个网络仍然可以通过从其他图像中归纳出来来找到它,但是它没有经过训练.

blocks.en:
A coarse target faces two separate limits: whether a region is assigned a cell at all, and how well whole cells reproduce its shape.
A 2 × 2 2{\times}2 nucleus inside an 8 × 8 8{\times}8 cell of background is lost by majority pooling; kept, its whole-cell mask reaches an IoU of only 4 / 64 4/64 .
Both fail an IoU-0.5 test, but only the kept nucleus gives a shape-predicting head a cell from which to regress its outline.
Small size alone does not force a loss: tiny regions survive whenever enough distinct cells are available, whereas of k k regions that lie inside a single cell and touch no other, at most one can be kept.
Keeping every region is therefore not always possible, because several regions can compete for the same few cells.
Soft-label downsampling [ 1 ] keeps the class proportions of each cell but does not specify which regions are kept.
Greedy rescue recovers about half of the lost regions on COCO and nearly all lost nuclei, but it has no guarantee and can keep as few as k + 1 k{+}1 of 4 ​ k + 1 4k{+}1 regions ( Sec. 3.7 ).
Chen and Peng’s topology-preserving integer program [ 7 ] handles binary masks and can be infeasible.
None of these methods determines how many regions can be kept on a given grid, which losses are unavoidable, or which target attains the maximum.

这些方法都无法确定有多少区域可以保留在特定网格上,哪些损失是不可避免的,或哪些目标达到最大值。

blocks.en:
We answer these questions with MatchDown (matching-based downsampling), which builds coarse targets from the support graph between regions and the grid cells that contain them ( Fig. 1 c).
With priority tiers (MatchDown-P), it keeps every evaluated region of at least one cell’s area and loses only the minimum number of evaluated regions.
Our analysis has three parts. Exact survival: the sets of regions that can be kept together are the independent sets of a transversal matroid, and every region of at least one cell’s area can be kept, because k k such regions touch at least k k cells.
A single minimum-cost matching attains the maximum with the least pixel disagreement. Lower bound and certificates: every unavoidable loss is certified by a cluster of k k regions that share fewer than k k cells. Costs: a coverage threshold admits the same exact count, a per-region bound limits the IoU that any coarse target can reach (no region that majority pooling loses can exceed IoU 0.5), and a constrained repair removes some of the spurious adjacencies that keeping more regions introduces.
We build on classical results [ 25 , 18 , 17 ] and solve with standard minimum-cost matching [ 29 ] ; our contribution is the formulation and its guarantees.

具有优先级( MatchDown- P) , 它保存着每个至少一个单元格区域的评价区域, 并且只损失评价区域的最低数量 。

blocks.en:
On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of evaluated regions and none of a cell or more, while the standard methods lose four to five times the minimum on COCO at factor 8 ( Fig. 2 ).
The kept regions are reconstructed coarsely: on COCO-R at factor 8, the share of reachable regions reconstructed at IoU 0.5 falls from 98.4% for majority pooling to 89.5% ( Tab. 1 ), and none of the regions that majority pooling loses can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target ( Proposition 5 ).
The kept regions still help a shape-predicting head: trained on MatchDown targets, a star-convex head segments 35% of the BBBC038 nuclei missing from the majority target above IoU 0.5, against 15% on majority targets and 24% on StarDist’s strided target.
With cross-validated thresholds it has the lowest count error of the targets in Tab. 2 , with Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 below cell-center sampling; on BBBC038 the strided head has the lower count error when the NMS range is extended to 0.1 ( Tab. S13 ).
On BBBC039 at factor 16, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, detects 30% of the nuclei missing from the majority target, against 3% for the head trained on that target, and lowers count error by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} .
On BBBC038 at factor 8, greedy rescue and a full-resolution loss match MatchDown’s count reduction, the latter at higher Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} ; building a MatchDown target takes 1.7 to 1.9 times as long as majority pooling.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Exact region survival on a fixed coarse grid: a matching formulation of label downsampling with maximum-survival targets at minimum disagreement, loss certificates and the one-cell guarantee. • Assignment versus reconstruction: a per-region IoU bound that no region lost by majority pooling can exceed, and evidence that a shape-predicting head recovers such regions beyond it. • A label-level evaluation and training results against the downsampling of StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids, with two heads on two nucleus datasets. Code and all coarse targets will be released.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Fully convolutional networks predict at a stride and upsample [ 36 ] ; DeepLab computed its loss against ground truth subsampled by 8 [ 8 ] .
Dense detectors assign objects to the cells of a strided grid: YOLO [ 46 ] and CenterNet [ 57 ] give each object one cell, FCOS [ 51 ] assigns the cells inside a box with a rule for cells claimed by several boxes, and SOLO [ 53 ] predicts one instance per grid cell; CenterNet reports how often two object centers fall into the same output cell on COCO.
ATSS [ 56 ] , OTA [ 23 ] and the bipartite matching of DETR [ 6 ] choose during training which predictions are supervised by which objects.
MatchDown acts on the label map instead: before training, it decides which regions a one-region-per-cell target can contain.
StarDist [ 48 , 54 ] trains from per-cell targets, and SSAP predicts affinities at strides 4 to 64 [ 22 ] .
Affinity- and watershed-based decoders [ 52 , 21 , 55 , 3 ] , U-Net [ 47 ] , Cellpose [ 50 ] , HoVer-Net [ 24 ] and Omnipose [ 12 ] are usually trained at full resolution, and Mask2Former computes its mask loss at points sampled from the full-resolution label [ 9 ] ; none of these needs a coarse target.
blocks.zh:
完全演化的网络以一个起伏起伏的标本预测 [36]; DeepLab根据8 [8] 的地表真象对它的损失进行了计算。
ense探测器将对象分配到被扭曲的网格的单元格:YOLO [46]和CenterNet [57] 给每个对象一个单元格,FCOS [51] 给一个盒子内的单元格分配一个规则,用于数个箱要求的单元格,而SOLO [53] 预测每个网格单元格有一个实例;CenterNet 报告COCO上两个对象中心经常会落入同一个输出单元格.
ATSS [56],OTA [23] 以及DETR [6]在训练期间选择的双相配对,在训练中监督预测对象.
MatchDown在标签图上的行为代替:在训练前,它决定每个细胞一个区域的目标可以包含哪个区域.
StarDist [48,54] 从每个细胞目标出发的列车, 和SSAP 预测相近 步向4到64 [22].
Afffinity-和分水岭解码器[52,21,55,3],U-Net [47],Cellpose [50],HoVer-Net [24]和Ommipose [12]通常都接受完全解析的训练,而Mask2Former在从全解分标签中抽取的点上计算其口罩损失;这些都不需要粗略的目标.

blocks.en:
Soft-label downsampling replaces the hard coarse label by the class proportions of each cell [ 1 ] .
Soft labels keep class information that a hard argmax discards, but they do not distinguish two regions of the same class or specify which regions remain represented.
We produce hard, region-valued targets with a guarantee on which regions are kept, and Sec. 4.6 trains both kinds on the same images.
blocks.zh:
软标签下采样将硬粗标签替换为每个单元格的类比例 [1].
软标签保留了硬正弦丢弃的类信息,但是它们没有区分同类的两个区域,也没有指定哪些区域仍然具有代表性.
我们生产硬的、具有区域价值的目标,保证在哪些地区保留,第4.6sec.在相同的图像上进行这两种培训。

blocks.en:
Chen and Peng [ 7 ] downsample binary images with an integer program.
Whenever the program is feasible, it keeps every component and the region adjacency graph, and hence b 0 b_{0} and b 1 b_{1} .
Its constraints give every component a cell of its own, so it is infeasible whenever Hall’s condition fails on its support graph; our reimplementation returns no solution in 22 of 300 cases (21 infeasible, one time-out), four of them for this reason ( Appendix D ).
We address partitions with many labels and always return a labeling, but we guarantee less: maximum survival, and a repair that never increases the number of coarse components of a region; we guarantee neither holes nor exact adjacency ( Sec. 3.7 ).
SEMIR [ 39 ] and topology-preserving transformations [ 41 , 45 , 13 ] change the lattice or preserve topology under resampling, without an objective on which regions are kept; we keep the regular coarse grid that standard networks predict on.
blocks.zh:
陈和鹏 [7] 有整数程序的下镜二进制图像.
只要程序可行,它就保留每个组件和地区相接图,从而b 0 b_{0}和b 1 b_{1}。

Matching regions to cells appears in grid-map layout [ 20 ] , where regions may be placed in any cell rather than only in cells they occupy.
Our survival theorems apply Hall’s theorem, the transversal-matroid theorem and the Dulmage–Mendelsohn decomposition [ 25 , 18 , 17 , 31 , 43 , 27 , 37 , 44 ] to the support graph of a downsampling, and we solve the resulting problems with standard minimum-cost matching algorithms [ 32 , 40 , 29 , 11 ] .

We compare MatchDown with the downsampling methods of existing pipelines: strided sampling (StarDist’s target, and PyTorch’s default nearest interpolation), nearest-exact (nnU-Net v2’s deep supervision), nearest sampling at the cell center, majority pooling (the mode, as in connectomics pyramids), max pooling, one-hot bilinear interpolation with argmax, and nnU-Net’s per-label interpolation [ 28 ] .
We also compare soft labels [ 1 ] , greedy and maximal rescue, a full-resolution loss where one can be computed, and, at the label level, Chen and Peng’s integer program [ 7 ] .
MatchDown denotes the unweighted construction ( Theorem 3 with the repair) and MatchDown-P its tiered form ( Algorithm 1 ).

blocks.en:
We train two heads on the 670 BBBC038 images at factor 8, and on the 197 BBBC039 images at factor 16 ( Tab. 2 ); the factor is the output stride of the head, which StarDist calls the grid.
Each head is trained with nine seeds and three folds, so every image is predicted by a model that never saw it, and we score at full resolution. Some BBBC038 models come from a second set of runs with the same protocol (App. C ); every difference is computed within one set.
The affinity head (ResNet-18 FPN [ 26 , 34 ] ) predicts foreground and same-nucleus affinities at the target stride and is decoded by thresholding and connected components.
The star-convex head predicts an object probability and 32 radial distances in each grid cell, as StarDist does [ 48 ] (our reimplementation), and is decoded by non-maximum suppression.
Both heads require a coarse target, because each grid cell carries one object. We name each model by its head and target ( e.g . , the MatchDown affinity head); Tab. S2 lists the hyper-parameters.

blocks.en:
The nuclei that majority pooling and the other methods lose are mostly smaller than a grid cell ( Fig. 2 b), and by Proposition 5 none of the regions that majority pooling loses is reachable; on BBBC038 at factor 8 the mean IoU bound of these nuclei is 0.30.
The reachable share falls below half on all three datasets at factor 16 ( Fig. S4 b).
An affinity head outputs one label per cell, so it can detect these nuclei but not segment them at IoU > 0.5 {}>0.5 : 89% of its count reduction on BBBC038 comes from nuclei that the majority model misses and the MatchDown model detects, and no affinity model matches any of them at IoU > 0.5 {}>0.5 .
Each such detection counts as a false positive at IoU > 0.5 {}>0.5 and lowers the Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} of the MatchDown affinity models ( Fig. S8 c).
The star-convex head decodes polygons at full resolution and is not limited by the bound: it matches more of these nuclei at IoU > 0.5 {}>0.5 whenever its target keeps them, 33% on rescue, 35% on MatchDown and 40% on dilated targets, against 15% on majority and 24% on strided targets ( Tab. S12 ).

blocks.en: The tiers decide which regions are kept when not all can be: on COCO-R at factor 8, MatchDown-P loses 1,854 evaluated regions, the lower bound, and the unweighted MatchDown 3,185 ( Tab. 1 ), at a cost of at most 0.02% of pixels ( Appendix D ).

On BBBC038 at factor 8, greedy rescue loses 103 of the 29,461 nuclei and performs as well as MatchDown with both heads ( Tabs. 3 and S12 ). Exact matching matters where cells are scarce: on BBBC039 at factors 16 to 32, rescue loses more nuclei than MatchDown-P on 33 to 99% of the images ( Tab. S9 ); at factor 16 its heads have 1.4 to 3.1 points higher Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} , and only the affinity head counts worse, by 0.60 nuclei per image ( Tab. S16 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
The regions a coarse target can keep are determined exactly by a matching problem: every region of a cell or more can be kept, a minimum-cost matching attains the maximum, and every unavoidable loss has a certificate.
Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are separate bottlenecks: the regions that majority pooling loses cannot be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of them above that IoU, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist’s strided target.
Across the three star-convex settings, with cross-validated thresholds, this head has the lowest count error of the targets in Tab. 2 and Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target.
An affinity head, with cell-level output, lowers count error but loses Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} , because it can only reconstruct what the cells can.

We chose the second training dataset among BBBC039 and NuInsSeg [ 38 ] at factors 8 and 16 by a rule fixed before training: among the pairs whose majority and MatchDown-P targets differ by at least 2 nuclei per image in oracle count error, take the largest difference.

blocks.en: Strided sampling takes the first pixel of each cell ( lbl[::f,::f] , PyTorch’s default nearest interpolation and StarDist’s target). Nearest (cell center) takes pixel ⌊ ( f − 1 ) / 2 ⌋ \lfloor(f-1)/2\rfloor of each cell along each axis, and nearest-exact pixel f / 2 f/2 (PyTorch’s nearest-exact, used by nnU-Net’s deep supervision). Majority pooling gives each cell its most frequent region (lowest index on ties); the class-first variant takes the most frequent class, then the most frequent region of that class, with void and crowd counted as classes. Max pooling takes the largest label index in each cell. One-hot bilinear + argmax interpolates the one-hot label maps bilinearly and takes the argmax. nnU-Net per-label interpolation is resize_segmentation of batchgenerators with order 1: each region is interpolated separately and written where it reaches 0.5, in ascending order, and our implementation reproduces the library output exactly. Smallest-region priority gives each cell the smallest region that covers at least a quarter of it. Greedy and maximal rescue are defined in Sec. 3.7 , and dilated targets label every cell a nucleus touches with that nucleus.

The 670 BBBC038 stage-1 training images are split into three folds stratified by image size, and the 197 BBBC039 images into three folds; each fold’s model trains on the other two, so every image is predicted once per target and seed by a model that never saw it.
Every target is computed once per image before training and cropped and transformed with the image.
On BBBC038, the nearest-target affinity model in Tab. S10 , all star-convex models ( Tabs. S12 and S13 ), and the models in Tab. S11 use a second run set with the same protocol. The cell-center affinity model in Tab. 2 was rerun in the first set. Every difference is computed within one run set.

blocks.en:
The affinity head’s target gives each cell its region’s foreground label and each pair of neighboring foreground cells an affinity of 1 when they hold the same region; unassigned cells are background.
Soft labels replace these by the nucleus fraction of each cell and, for two neighboring cells, the probability that a nucleus pixel drawn from each belongs to the same nucleus [ 1 ] .
The full-resolution loss upsamples the stride- f f logits bilinearly and supervises every pixel with the foreground and the same-nucleus label of the pixel pair that its cell-level channel describes.
In the masked target, the cells of the nuclei missing from the majority target carry no loss.
Every cell of the star-convex target that is assigned to a nucleus is supervised with the same description of it: probability 1, the offset from the cell center to the pixel of the nucleus farthest from its boundary (which always lies inside the nucleus), and the 32 ray distances from that pixel, computed as in StarDist.

软标签用每个细胞的核分数来取而代之,对于相邻的两个细胞来说,从每个细胞中抽取出一个核像素的概率属于同一个核 [1].
完全解析的丢失可以对脚步- f 双向日志进行上标并用其细胞级通道所描述的像素对像素对像素对像素对像素对的前地和同核标签来监督每个像素.
在被蒙蔽的目标中,从多数目标中缺失的核细胞没有丢失.
分配给核糖体的每个恒星-视线靶标的细胞都接受同样的描述:概率1,从细胞中心到离其边界最远的核糖体像素的相抵(它总是位于核糖体内部),以及从该像素中计算出32个射线距离.

blocks.en:
For each model, seed and held-out fold, the cross-validated thresholds minimize the mean count error over the images of the other two folds on the grid of Tab. S2 , each image scored by its own held-out model; ties go to the point nearest the default, then to the smaller thresholds.
For the equal-FP point, each model takes the pair with the lowest count error among those whose FP50 on the tuning folds does not exceed the majority model’s at its cross-validated pair, or the pair with the fewest false positives if none does.
With every point of the grid decoded, the default points reproduce the default-threshold scores exactly.
Because the thresholds minimize count error, Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} and F1 at them describe a count-calibrated operating point.
The models that predict the tuning folds were trained on images that include the evaluated fold.
In a fully nested check, we selected the affinity thresholds of BBBC038 on one half of each held-out fold and evaluated them on the other half, so that neither the model nor the thresholds saw the evaluated images.
The MatchDown model’s count error is then 1.03 nuclei per image lower than the majority model’s, lower in all nine seeds, with Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} 1.2 points lower and 1.6 more false positives per image, the same pattern as with cross-validated thresholds; the equal-FP constraint can be met in 37 of the 54 seed, fold and half combinations.

A difference between two targets is the mean over the nine seeds of the per-seed mean over images of the per-image difference.
Its 95% interval comes from 10,000 bootstrap samples that resample seeds and then images, with all targets sharing each resample, so that the pairing of targets on the same seed, fold and image is kept [ 19 , 14 ] ; the seed-level spread is scaled by a Student- t t factor for nine seeds.
Thresholds are fixed across bootstrap samples, so the intervals cover the variation over seeds and images.

blocks.en:
An exact integer program (HiGHS) found the fewest spurious adjacent pairs at maximum survival on 200 random 64 × 64 64{\times}64 BSDS crops: the repair attains it on 92.0 to 92.5% of the crops, with a mean gap of 0.09 pairs and a maximum of 3, against 0.19 to 0.20 for the assignment alone.
The program omits the component guard, so the gap is conservative.
On 100 binary masks (50 BSDS, 50 COCO) at factors 2, 4 and 8, our reimplementation of Chen and Peng’s integer program [ 7 ] preserves binary topology exactly whenever it returns a solution, but it returns none in 22 of the 300 cases: 21 are infeasible and one reaches the time limit, which does not establish infeasibility.
We test Hall’s condition on the program’s own support graph, which differs from ours: its components are 8-connected in the foreground and 4-connected in the background, the mask is padded with a background ring of f f pixels, and a component may take any cell whose block, dilated by ⌊ f / 4 ⌋ \lfloor f/4\rfloor pixels, holds one of its pixels.
Because the program gives every component a cell of its own, a Hall violation on this graph makes it infeasible.
Four of the infeasible cases violate the condition, and in all four the deficient components are background pieces enclosed by foreground; the other 17 infeasible cases and the time-out satisfy it, so the 17 fail for other constraints of the program, and no solved case violates the condition.
MatchDown always returns a labeling and preserves binary topology exactly on 60 to 88% of the masks; it loses 0 to 11 of 170 BSDS components and 0 to 21 of 300 COCO components, against 27 to 58 and 74 to 110 for majority pooling, with a mean IoU at most 0.023 lower. Table S8 gives the run time.
blocks.zh:
一个精确的整数程序(HIGHS)在200个随机64×6464×Times}64个BSDS作物上发现了最小的相邻假配对:修复后在92.0%到92.5%的作物上得到了它,平均相差0.09对,最高相差3分,而单任务就只有0.19到0.20分.
程序省略了组件后卫,因此缺口保守.
在100个二进制口罩(50个BSDS,50个COCO)的因子2,4和8上,我们重新执行陈和彭的整数程序[7],只要它返回一个解决方案,就完全保留了二进制的地貌,但是在300个案例中,有22个没有返回:21个不可行,1个达到时限,这并不能确定不可行.
我们测试Hall在程序自身支持图上的状况,它不同于我们:它的组件在前地有8个连接,在后地有4个连接,面具被加上ff像素的背景环,一个组件可以取取出由 QQ f / 4 \ llode f/4\rlode像素放大而持有其一个像素的单元格.
因为程序给每个组件一个自己的细胞,因此这个图上的"霍尔"(Hall)侵犯使得它不可行.
4起不可行的案件违反了条件,在所有4起缺陷的组件中,都是被前方所包围的背景片;其他17起不可行的案件和超时令令令其满意,因此17起因程序的其他限制而失败,没有破案就违反了条件.
MatchDown总是在60到88%的口罩上返回一个标签并保存二进制地貌;它损失了170个BSDS组件中的0到11个和300个COCO组件中的0到21个,而多数集合时则损失了27到58个和74到110个,平均IoU最多低于0.023个. 表S8给出运行时间.

blocks.en:
Tables S10 and S12 give every BBBC038 model at the default and cross-validated thresholds, and Tab. 2 summarizes them; Fig. S8 shows where the count reduction of the affinity head comes from. Table S11 separates keeping the nuclei from how their cells are assigned.
Excluding the cells of the missing nuclei from the loss recovers 0.93 nuclei per image of majority’s count error at no Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} cost, and MatchDown recovers a further 1.08 [ 0.84 , 1.32 ] [0.84,1.32] at an Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} cost of 1.3 points (paired difference between the two models).
A dilated target keeps every nucleus but enlarges each one by up to a ring of cells; its affinity model loses 23 Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} points, and its star-convex model reaches 2.9 Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} points below MatchDown at the default thresholds, with 12 more false positives per image.
At factor 4 the strided target loses only 0.43% of the nuclei and recovers most of the Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} difference to factor 8, at 3.3 more false positives per image.

一个被放大的目标保持了每一个核,但每个核的放大可达一圈细胞;它的亲和性模型损失了23 Acc 50\mathrm{Acc\\50}分,它的恒星-凸起模型在默认阈值下达到2.9 Acc 50\mathrm{Acc\\\50}分数,每个图像还有12个假阳性.

Figure S9 shows the affinity models over the threshold grid.
For the star-convex head the selected NMS threshold lies at the lower edge of the grid, 0.3, for the strided and MatchDown models; Tab. S13 extends the grid to 0.1.
Under the extension, the Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} difference between MatchDown and strided shrinks from 4.2 to 1.9 points at factor 8 and from 1.4 to 0.4 at factor 4, and the count errors move in both directions because a few large images dominate them at the new points.
On BBBC038 the nearest model’s cross-validated count error (5.78) is above its default (5.04), because thresholds selected on the tuning folds remove too many detections on the held-out fold.

blocks.en:
Tables S14 and S15 give the nine BBBC039 models and the differences between their targets, and Fig. S10 shows two more images with all trained models.
With cross-validated thresholds, the MatchDown-P affinity model has a count error 9.3 [ 8.2 , 10.4 ] [8.2,10.4] nuclei per image lower than the majority model at an Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} cost of 7.2 [ 6.7 , 7.7 ] [6.7,7.7] points.
The majority and nearest affinity models select the corner of the grid (lowest foreground and highest affinity threshold), so no MatchDown-P threshold pair reaches their false-positive rate; the MatchDown-P models select interior points. Table S16 adds greedy rescue and soft labels at factor 16.
The affinity model trained on rescue targets has a count error 0.60 [ 0.26 , 0.97 ] [0.26,0.97] higher than the MatchDown-P model, 0.85 of the difference between the targets themselves, with 4.7 fewer false positives, Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} 3.1 points higher, and 4.6 points fewer of the nuclei missing from its own target detected.
Soft labels raise the count error by 11.5 [ 10.6 , 12.5 ] [10.6,12.5] and detect 24.8 points fewer of the nuclei missing from the majority target, at Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} 5.5 points higher.
With the star-convex head, rescue and MatchDown-P have equal count error within the interval ( − 0.36 -0.36 [ − 2.95 , + 1.09 ] [-2.95,+1.09] ), rescue’s Acc 50 \mathrm{Acc}_{50} is 1.4 points higher, and its matched share of the nuclei missing from the strided target is within 0.015 of MatchDown-P’s.
blocks.zh:
表格S14和S15给出了9个BBBC039模型及其目标的差异,而Fig. S10则展示了另外两个带有所有训练有素模型的图像.
具有交叉验证的阈值,MatchDown-P亲和度模型在Acc 50\mathrm{Acc}_{50}成本为7.2 [6.7, 7.7] [6.7,7.7]分时,每个图像的核数有9.3 [8.2, 10.4] [8.2,10.4] 低于多数模型.
大多数和最接近的亲和率模型会选择网格的一角(最低的前缘和最亲和度阈值),因此没有MatchDown-P的阈值对会达到其虚假正率;MatchDown-P模型会选择内部点. 表S16在因数16上增加了贪婪的救援和软标签.
接受救援目标训练的亲和模型有0.60 [0.26,0.97] [0.26,0.97] 比MatchDown-P模型高,是目标本身相差的0.85分,假阳性值减少4.7分,Acc 50\mathrm{Acc}_{-}_{50}高3.1分,从自己发现的目标上少了4.6分.
软标签将计数误差提高11.5 [10.6, 12.5] [10.6, 12.5] 并探测到多数目标中少了24.8分的核糖体,在Acc 50\mathrm{Acc}_{-}_{50}5.5分高.
以恒星-凸起头,救援和MatchDown-P在间隔(-0.36-0.36 [-2.95,+1.09] [-2.95,+1.09])内有等分计分误差,救援的Acc 50\mathrm{Acc-}_{50}比分高1.4分,其所对应的被扭曲目标缺失的核子比例在MatchDown-P的0.015以内.
